mentions.name: Jetson Face AF
mentions.description: A tech demo that augments a Nikon camera's autofocus with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano: video flows from the camera over HDMI to the Jetson for processing, and focus control is sent back over USB. The goal is face-priority autofocus that knows which faces the photographer cares about, augmenting rather than replacing the camera's AF while keeping Nikon's shooting ergonomics intact.
mentions.problem: Nikon AF does a great job of recognizing faces, but it doesn't know which faces the photographer cares about; even flagship cameras lag the processing power of external hardware like a Jetson Nano and lack an easy external processing loop for extra smarts and automation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I hacked together a tech demo of a personal project to add a Jetson Orin Nano to augment the Nikon autofocus system. (Camera->HDMI->Jetson processing->USB control->Camera)
